case.goal: Repair stable_unique(items) to return a new list retaining the first occurrence of each equality-distinct item in input order. Support unhashable values such as lists and dictionaries, and do not mutate the input.
case.checks:
from unique import stable_unique
values=[[1],[2],[1],{"a":1},{"a":1},[3]]
before=repr(values)
assert stable_unique(values)==[[1],[2],{"a":1},[3]]
assert repr(values)==before
assert stable_unique([3,1,3,2,1])==[3,1,2]
assert stable_unique([])==[]
x=["a","a"];result=stable_unique(x)
assert result==["a"] and result is not x

case.goal: Repair parse_port(value). Accept either a strict int (bool is invalid) or a nonempty string containing only ASCII digits, including leading zeros. Return the integer only in the inclusive range 1..65535. Reject every other value with ValueError, including signs, whitespace, non-ASCII digits and floats.

Repair Cache(clock). put(key,value,ttl) must accept only a strict positive int ttl (bool is invalid), raise ValueError before changing state for invalid ttl, and replace that key with an expiry of clock()+ttl. get(key,default=None) returns the stored value strictly before expiry; at or after expiry it removes the expired entry and returns default. Preserve falsy values and unrelated keys.
case.checks:
from cache import Cache
now=[10]
c=Cache(lambda:now[0]);c.put("a",0,2);c.put("b",False,10)
assert c.get("a","missing")==0
now[0]=11;assert c.get("a","missing")==0
now[0]=12;assert c.get("a","missing")=="missing"
assert c.get("b","missing") is False
now[0]=10;assert c.get("a","missing")=="missing"
c.put("x","old",9)
for bad in [0,-1,True,1.5,"2",None]:
    try:
        c.put("x","bad",bad)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(repr(bad))
    assert c.get("x")=="old"
c.put("b","new",2);now[0]=12
assert c.get("b","missing")=="missing"
assert c.get("absent",7)==7
